summary: Backend-only regression + verification for the new 🔐 Show Password (VPS password recovery) feature and the earlier DigitalOcean SSH-based reset fix. All targets green: /api/dev/vps-password-reveal-check = pass=true 24/24, /api/dev/vps-password-fix-check = pass=true 23/23, node E2E sandbox = 8/8, /api/health healthy+connected, ai-support-health pass=true, no leftover test docs in vpsPasswordSecrets. Security gate on the reveal-check dev endpoint returns 403 with no key and 403 with wrong key (BOT_ENVIRONMENT=development confirmed). Code review of goto.revealVpsPassword and vps-secret-store / azure-service / vultr-service confirmed all requested properties.
critical_code_review_comments: js/_index.js goto.revealVpsPassword (lines 11752-11788): (a) reads vpsPlansOf.findOne({chatId,vpsId}) to recover rootPasswordSecretId/sshKeySecretId/defaultUser that fetchVPSDetails omits — OK; (b) SSH keys loaded via fetchUserSSHPrivateKeys(chatId, record.sshKeySecretId) from js/vm-instance-setup.js — OK; (c) password is only sent when res.status==='ok' && res.password (else vp.revealPasswordNotStored / vp.revealPasswordFailed) — OK, no leak on failure; (d) success message vp.revealPasswordSuccess passes host+username(root/Administrator)+isRDP+verification, and 'reveal message shows port, username and a connect command' + 'RDP reveal shows port 3389, not 22' assertions both pass in the dev endpoint checks — OK.

js/vps-secret-store.js: Mongo-backed CRUD over vpsPasswordSecrets collection (init at line 33, getSecretPassword line 69). In-process Map retained only as a cache — durability across process restarts confirmed by the two 'passwords survive a redeploy' checks in the dev endpoint.

js/azure-service.js and js/vultr-service.js both define _rememberPwdSecret() (azure:590, vultr:347) that mirrors every password write into the durable store, and both export async getSecretPassword() delegating to vps-secret-store (azure:601/1430, vultr:358/822). All password-write sites (azure lines 848, 1080, 1296; vultr lines 533, 582, 669) call _rememberPwdSecret — no orphaned writes.
Reveal-check dev endpoint self-cleans: post-run Mongo query for _id matching /revealtest|durable-/ in vpsPasswordSecrets returned 0 documents.
